programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: On this episode of North American Whitetail, Editor-in-Chief Haynes Shelton and Associate editor Blake Garlock kick off the season by crossing the border to Canada pursuing big deer in Alberta. Blake walks us though on how to plan for big swings in temperatures on our From The Stand Segment, and we learn about buying the right compact tractor from Dr. James Kroll on our Build Your Own Deer Factory. Big Buck Profile heads to the Iowa Deer Classic where Haynes spends time looking at the Mike Weatherly buck!

programme.title: North American Whitetail
programme.desc: The team is back at it again in Alberta Canada. Haynes Shelton and Blake Garlock finish their hunt at Warcry Outfitters. On Our From The Stand Segment, Blake walks us through Browning's X-Bolt 2 and Dr. Kroll teaches us how to cut and plant through Thick Grass Thatch. We also head back to the Iowa Deer Classic where Haynes walks us through the new number 3 Sam Iopa Buck!

programme.title: Bowhunter
programme.desc: Curt Wells and Spot Hogg's Kris Christensen kick off our 20th Season hunting with Saskatchewan big-bear guide Rob Nye.

programme.desc: Danny Farris and son, Lane, hunt Merriam's gobblers with well-known Montana bowhunter Yahsti Perkinskiller.

programme.title: In-Fisherman TV
programme.desc: It’s all about tricks of the trade and sleight of hand in pursuit of feverish fishing, as the in-Fisherman staff wrenches bruiser smallmouths from shallow river haunts; travels to the St. Clair River near Detroit to battle a sturdy and spirited opponent, the lake sturgeon; and takes you “down a historic road if discovery” to explore a pioneering tradition of fishing for inshore fish like tarpon, redfish, snook, and stripers.

programme.title: In-Fisherman TV
programme.desc: It’s freshwater fishing action in overdrive, with emphasis on top tactical maneuvers and precision lure presentation, as the In-Fisherman staff casts big baits for night-prowling walleyes; goes all froggy for post spawn largemouth bass; and takes you “down a historic road of discovery” in the quest for giant pike.
